L: Nam: Okay team, who's in charge of the music for the lake picnic?
Hoa: I'll make a playlist! I'm obsessed with indie songs right now.
Bao: Please no sad songs. We want upbeat stuff to sing along to.
Hoa: Haha, fair enough. I'll add some old classics too.
Nam: Nice! Is anyone bringing a speaker? My phone is too quiet.
Bao: I've got a portable one. I'll bring it, no worries.
Hoa: Perfect. Send me your favourite songs by Friday night!

exq.q: Chỗ trống 1: Okay team, who's ___ charge of the music for the lake picnic?
exq.why: be in charge of = phụ trách.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 2: I'm ___ with indie songs right now.
exq.why: be obsessed with = mê mẩn; sau am là tính từ.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 3: We want upbeat stuff to sing ___ to.
Chỗ trống 4: Haha, fair ___. I'll add some old classics too.
exq.why: Fair enough = cũng phải (chấp nhận ý bạn).
Bao: “I've got a portable one. I'll bring it.”

exq.q: What does Hoa ask everyone to do by Friday night?
exq.why: Hoa: “Send me your favourite songs by Friday night!”
